subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can play a dice game and say You're wearing …
I can take turns using game language.
I can find differences and write sentences about them.

tf.s: We say My turn! before we roll the dice.
tf.why: Yes! My turn! means it is my go.

tf.s: In the game we say: You're wearing a green T-shirt.
We say Well done! when a friend does well.
tf.why: Great! Well done! is kind game language.

tf.s: We say: You wearing a hijab.
tf.why: We need You're: You're wearing a hijab.
Yes! They are things we have.

tf.s: A difference is something that is the same in two pictures.
tf.why: A difference is something that is not the same.

tf.s: In picture A, they're wearing red jackets. In picture B, they're wearing green jackets. This is a difference.
When it is your partner's go, we say My turn!
tf.why: We say Your turn! for a partner's go.

tf.s: A tracksuit is clothes for sport.
tf.why: Right! We wear tracksuits for sport.

tf.s: Slippers are a possession, like a phone.
tf.why: Slippers are clothes we wear on our feet.

hunt.q: Not the same in two pictures

mcq.q: What do you say when you roll and get three?
mcq.why: We say the number we roll.
Your turn! is used in games.

mcq.q: Which word is in the word search list?
mcq.why: Slippers is one of the unit words.

mcq.q: Which of these is a possession word from the unit?
mcq.why: Keys are a thing we have, not clothes.

mcq.q: Your partner is wearing a red coat. What do you say?
Picture A: purple bags. Picture B: orange bags. Write the difference.
o: In picture A, the bags are purple. In picture B, the bags are orange.
In picture A, the bags are orange.
mcq.why: Say what is in A and what is in B.

mcq.q: Your teacher puts on glasses. What is different?
o: Now the teacher is wearing glasses.
mcq.why: The new thing is the glasses.

mcq.q: Odd one out: phone, computer, handbag, jumper
mcq.why: A jumper is clothes; the others are possessions.

mcq.q: Why do we say Your turn! in the game?
o: To give the go to a partner
mcq.why: Taking turns makes the game fair.

mcq.q: Picture A: white trainers. Picture B: black shoes. How many things are different?
o: Two: the colour and the kind of shoes
Three: the price, size and name
mcq.why: White becomes black, and trainers become shoes.
